confirmed_bugs.symptom: FALSE_NEGATIVE: narrowing of xs[0] survives the assignment xs[0] = None (reveals int, ty/pyright say None); mypy misses a runtime TypeError. KNOWN upstream: python/mypy#20969 (open).

INCORRECT_INFERENCE: F.R | F.W on an enum.Flag is typed Literal[F.R, F.W] (assert_type(v, F) fails in ty, passes in mypy/pyright); the runtime value <F.R|W: 3> is neither member. KNOWN upstream: ty#3765 (closed, 'enum.Flag not supported yet'), ty#876 (open). Stronger witness: reviewer-min/bug-02-ty-flag-or-assert-type.py.

FALSE_NEGATIVE: mypy expands enum.Flag into a union of its members in 'is' narrowing, treats the else branch as unreachable and misses a runtime TypeError that ty and pyright report. Reviewer-found, no second judge. Same root cause as open python/mypy#21937.

FALSE_NEGATIVE: PEP 695 variance inference treats a mutable Callable[[T], None] attribute as contravariant (Handler[float] accepted as Handler[int]); runtime AttributeError. ty and pyright report invariance. No upstream issue found.

FALSE_NEGATIVE: TypeVar is never solved from a generic TypedDict argument (first(a) with a: Resp[int] is Unknown), so 'y: str = first(a)' is accepted and crashes at runtime; mypy and pyright report it. Reproduces on ty 0.0.84, 0.0.89 and 0.0.92. No exact upstream issue found (nearest: ty#4803, different path). Stronger witness: reviewer-min/bug-05-ty-generic-typeddict-crash-witness.py.
